phrases.latin: Pater puerō dormientī, antequam ex āëroplanō ēgrederentur, paenulam induit, clausūrā tractilī clausit, pilleum imposuit.
phrases.english: Before they got off the plane, Dad put the sleeping boy’s coat on, zipped it up and put on his cap.
phrases.source: Libellus VI, Reditus: per Alpēs domum

sources: Lewis & Short: clausura · Lewis & Short: tractilis
